args.summary: checkout-api began failing health checks following the v2.3.1 production deployment (v2.3.1 was unhealthy in production; v2.3.1-rc had also been unhealthy in staging). Mitigation: performed a production rollback in all regions (us-east, us-west, eu-west) from v2.3.1 to v2.3.0, the most recent release verified healthy in production. Post-rollback, checkout-api is healthy on v2.3.0 across all regions with an error rate of 0.2%. Follow-up: investigate the v2.3.1 changes that caused the health check failures before attempting a redeploy.
args.title: checkout-api health check failures after v2.3.1 deploy — rolled back to v2.3.0

trace.final:
All done. Summary of actions taken:

1. **Investigated the release history** for checkout-api: the latest deploy, **v2.3.1**, was unhealthy in production. The most recent version verified healthy in production was **v2.3.0**.
2. **Rolled back checkout-api to v2.3.0 in all production regions** (us-east, us-west, eu-west). Post-rollback verification shows the service healthy with an error rate of 0.2%.
3. **Opened a SEV2 incident (INC-0001)** for checkout-api, which paged the on-call engineer, documenting the health check failures after the v2.3.1 deploy, the rollback to v2.3.0, and a follow-up to investigate the v2.3.1 changes before any redeploy.

Note: the rollback was to a version already proven healthy in production, so change-manager approval was not required.
